```go
// handlerTransport answers HTTP requests in memory through h (no socket, no goroutine), so GSL
// round-trips can run inside a synctest bubble; see testutil.UseInMemoryGSL.
type handlerTransport struct{ h http.Handler }

func (rt handlerTransport) RoundTrip(r *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	rt.h.ServeHTTP(rec, r)
	return rec.Result(), nil
}

// TestRunCrossServerTestIOSResVersionAndCheckDeviceChange drives the cron path in iOS mode:
// check-version goes out as Android with the session zone (gate host and RSA key), then once more
// as the iOS build for resVersion; the Login carries the iOS-derived resVersion; and
// check.device.change follows init.
func TestRunCrossServerTestIOSResVersionAndCheckDeviceChange(t *testing.T) {
	t.Setenv("HOME", t.TempDir())
	pub := testutil.RSAPubKeyDER(t)

	var mu sync.Mutex
	var cvQueries []url.Values
	var gslCalls int
	handler := http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		mu.Lock()
		defer mu.Unlock()
		if !strings.HasSuffix(r.URL.Path, "getlsu3dversion.php") {
			gslCalls++
			http.NotFound(w, r)
			return
		}
		q := r.URL.Query()
		cvQueries = append(cvQueries, q)
		body := map[string]any{"resMsg": pub, "updateType": "3", "lwfile2": "826|1", "table_version": "39516,1,x", "locale": "23570,en",
			"hotUpdateMsg": "GameRes,2343,1,1;DllRes,1502,1,1"}
		if q.Get("platform") == "iOS" {
			body["lwfile2"], body["hotUpdateMsg"] = "821|1", "GameRes,2159,1,1;DllRes,1505,1,1"
		}
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(body)
	})
	orig := gsl.CheckVersionHosts
	gsl.CheckVersionHosts = []string{"http://gsl.invalid"}
	t.Cleanup(func() { gsl.CheckVersionHosts = orig })

	var loginResVersion string
	var afterInit []string
	dial := session.NewInMemoryGameDial(func(server *session.GameConn) {
		env, err := server.ReadEnvelope()
		if err != nil {
			return
		}
		if pv, ok := env.Content.Get("p"); ok {
			if p, ok := pv.Val.(*sfs.SFSObject); ok {
				mu.Lock()
				loginResVersion = p.GetString("resVersion")
				mu.Unlock()
			}
		}
		resp := sfs.NewSFSObject()
		resp.PutBool("success", true)
		if err := server.SendEnvelope(session.ControllerSystem, session.ActionLogin, resp); err != nil {
			return
		}
		if err := server.SendExtension("init", sfs.NewSFSObject()); err != nil {
			return
		}
		msg, err := session.ReadNextExtension(server)
		if err != nil {
			return
		}
		mu.Lock()
		afterInit = append(afterInit, msg.Cmd)
		mu.Unlock()
	})

	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		runCrossServerTest(crossServerTestOpts{
			ip: "gw.invalid", port: 10783, zone: "APS783", gameUid: "uid-1", at: "tok-1", iosMode: true,
			httpClient: &http.Client{Transport: handlerTransport{handler}},
			dialGame:   dial,
		})
		synctest.Wait()
	})

	mu.Lock()
	defer mu.Unlock()
	if loginResVersion != "2159.1505_821F_39516.23570" {
		t.Errorf("Login p.resVersion = %q, want the iOS-derived 2159.1505_821F_39516.23570", loginResVersion)
	}
	if len(cvQueries) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("check-version calls = %d, want 2 (Android for the gate host, iOS for resVersion)", len(cvQueries))
	}
	if q := cvQueries[0]; q.Get("platform") != "Android" || q.Get("server") != "APS783" || q.Get("table_env") != "table_online" {
		t.Errorf("first check-version = %v, want Android, server=APS783, table_env=table_online", q)
	}
	if q := cvQueries[1]; q.Get("platform") != "iOS" || q.Get("packageName") != "com.lastwar.ios" || q.Get("appVersion") != "1.0.344" ||
		q.Get("buildId") != "786" || q.Get("server") != "APS783" || q.Get("uid") != "" || q.Get("deviceId") != "" {
		t.Errorf("second check-version = %v, want the anonymous iOS 1.0.344/786 query", q)
	}
	if gslCalls != 0 {
		t.Errorf("getserverlist.php calls = %d, want 0 without -cs-rt", gslCalls)
	}
	if len(afterInit) != 1 || afterInit[0] != "check.device.change" {
		t.Errorf("first command after init = %v, want check.device.change", afterInit)
	}
}

// runReauthSubprocess re-runs this test binary as a subprocess with helperEnv set and returns its
// exit code and stderr; the subprocess side calls os.Exit through the code under test.
func runReauthSubprocess(t *testing.T, testName, helperEnv string) (int, string) {
	t.Helper()
	cmd := exec.Command(os.Args[0], "-test.run=^"+testName+"$")
	cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), helperEnv+"=1")
	var stderr bytes.Buffer
	cmd.Stderr = &stderr
	err := cmd.Run()
	exitErr, ok := err.(*exec.ExitError)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("subprocess did not exit with an error: err=%v stderr=%s", err, stderr.String())
	}
	return exitErr.ExitCode(), stderr.String()
}

// TestRunCrossServerTestRefreshReauthNeededExits2 covers MASTER §5.1 #4 on the -cs-rt path: GSL
// code 211 exits 2 with a re-auth message, even though the reply carries a server list.
func TestRunCrossServerTestRefreshReauthNeededExits2(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_HELPER_REAUTH_CSRT") == "1" {
		t.Setenv("HOME", t.TempDir())
		testutil.UseFakeGSLServer(t, testutil.NewFakeGSLServer(t, gsl.LoginServerListRespon{
			Code:       "211",
			ServerList: []gsl.LoginServerInfo{{IP: "127.0.0.1", Port: "1", Zone: "APS1", GameUid: "uid-1"}},
		}))
		runCrossServerTest(crossServerTestOpts{ip: "1.2.3.4", port: 18888, gameUid: "uid-1", rt: "some-refresh-token"})
		return
	}
	code, stderr := runReauthSubprocess(t, "TestRunCrossServerTestRefreshReauthNeededExits2", "LASTWAR_TEST_HELPER_REAUTH_CSRT")
	if code != 2 || !strings.Contains(stderr, "re-auth needed") {
		t.Errorf("exit code %d, want 2 with a re-auth message; stderr=%s", code, stderr)
	}
}
```

```go
package app

import (
	"fmt"
	"lastwar-client/internal/gsl"
	"lastwar-client/internal/session"
	"lastwar-client/internal/sfs"
	"lastwar-client/internal/testutil"

	"syscall"
	"testing"
)

// ownDeviceGSLReply is GSL's opt=login reply for the bound device: its own token pair and the
// servers of the account's two roles.
func ownDeviceGSLReply() gsl.LoginServerListRespon {
	return gsl.LoginServerListRespon{
		Code: "0", LastLoggedServer: "1",
		ServerList: []gsl.LoginServerInfo{
			{ID: "1", IP: "gw-1.example", Port: testutil.FlexPort(10001), Zone: "APS1", GameUid: "uid-1"},
			{ID: "783", IP: lookupGateways, Port: testutil.FlexPort(lookupPort), Zone: lookupZone, GameUid: "uid-783"},
		},
		At: &gsl.LoginToken{Token: "at-own", Time: "1791900000"},
		Rt: &gsl.LoginToken{Token: "rt-own", Time: "1791900000"},
	}
}

// emailBindingGameServer walks Login's email path and pushes an account with two roles: uid-1 on
// server 1 (the top-level pick) and uid-783 on 783, whose entry carries its own loginKey. Its
// init carries no buildings, so a plain -email run going on into the game sits out
// FetchBuildings' 12 s wait before exiting 0. mode "error" pushes an errorCode instead,
// as for a refused code; "kick" pushes push.user.off, as when the account logs in elsewhere.
func emailBindingGameServer(mode string) func(*session.GameConn) {
	return func(server *session.GameConn) {
		if _, err := server.ReadEnvelope(); err != nil {
			return
		}
		ok := sfs.NewSFSObject()
		ok.PutBool("success", true)
		if err := server.SendEnvelope(session.ControllerSystem, session.ActionLogin, ok); err != nil {
			return
		}
		if err := server.SendExtension("init", sfs.NewSFSObject()); err != nil {
			return
		}
		for _, cmd := range []string{"account.login.send.verify.code", "account.login.new"} {
			if _, err := session.ReadNextExtension(server); err != nil {
				return
			}
			if err := server.SendExtension(cmd, ok); err != nil {
				return
			}
		}
		push := sfs.NewSFSObject()
		switch mode {
		case "error":
			push.PutInt("errorCode", 208193)
			_ = server.SendExtension("push.account.login.new", push)
			return
		case "kick":
			_ = server.SendExtension("push.user.off", sfs.NewSFSObject())
			return
		}
		arr := sfs.NewSFSArray()
		for _, r := range []struct {
			id                  int32
			zone, uid, loginKey string
		}{{1, "APS1", "uid-1", ""}, {783, "APS783", "uid-783", "lk-role-783"}} {
			role := sfs.NewSFSObject()
			role.PutInt("id", r.id)
			role.PutUtfString("zone", r.zone)
			role.PutUtfString("gameUid", r.uid)
			if r.loginKey != "" {
				role.PutUtfString("loginKey", r.loginKey)
			}
			arr.AddSFSObject(role)
		}
		push.PutUtfString("loginKey", "lk-account")
		push.PutUtfString("gameUid", "uid-1")
		push.PutSFSArray("accountArr", arr)
		_ = server.SendExtension("push.account.login.new", push)
	}
}

// TestMainOwnDeviceSessionWithEmail runs Run() end to end in a subprocess, against a fake GSL and a
// fake game server: -email binding a device (with or without -server), -own-device-session trading
// its loginKey and writing the session config, and the cases around them.
func TestMainOwnDeviceSessionWithEmail(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_HELPER_PROCESS") == "1" {
		home := os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_HOME")
		t.Setenv("HOME", home)
		var replies []gsl.LoginServerListRespon
		if os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_BOUND") == "" {
			addr := session.StartFakeGameServer(t, emailBindingGameServer(os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_PUSH_MODE")))
			host, port := testutil.SplitHostPortInt(t, addr)
			// Login's opt=new/opt=fix: a guest token and the fake game server.
			replies = append(replies, gsl.LoginServerListRespon{Code: "0",
				ServerList: []gsl.LoginServerInfo{{IP: gsl.FlexString(host), Port: testutil.FlexPort(port), Zone: "APS1"}},
				At:         &gsl.LoginToken{Token: "at-guest"}})
		}
		testutil.UseFakeGSLServer(t, testutil.NewFakeGSLServer(t, append(replies, ownDeviceGSLReply())...))
		pipe := filepath.Join(home, "code.pipe")
		if err := syscall.Mkfifo(pipe, 0o600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		go func() {
			f, err := os.OpenFile(pipe, os.O_WRONLY, 0)
			if err != nil {
				return
			}
			defer func() { _ = f.Close() }()
			_, _ = f.WriteString("123456\n")
		}()
		args := []string{"lastwar-client", "-no-config", "-code-pipe", pipe}
		if os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_PLAIN") == "" {
			args = append(args, "-own-device-session", filepath.Join(home, "own.json"))
		}
		os.Args = append(args, strings.Fields(os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_ARGS"))...)
		Run()
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "run returned")
		return
	}

	bound := map[string]string{".lastwar_goclient_device_id": "dev_n3d", ".lastwar_goclient_loginkey": "lk-account", ".lastwar_goclient_gameuid": "uid-783"}
	type tc struct {
		name, args   string
		seed         map[string]string
		plain        bool   // no -own-device-session: the plain -email login
		pushMode     string // emailBindingGameServer's mode
		wantCode     int
		wantLog      []string
		noLog        []string
		wantGameUid  string // the persisted gameUid, and the config's when one is written
		wantLoginKey string // the persisted loginKey ("" = none)
		wantZone     string // the config's zone; "" = no config written
		wantDeviceID string // the config's deviceId when seeded
	}
	for _, c := range []tc{

			wantLog:     []string{"ignoring -server because -email is not set", "wrote own-device session config"},
			wantGameUid: "uid-783", wantLoginKey: "lk-account", wantZone: lookupZone, wantDeviceID: "dev_n3d"},
		{name: "reused guest (username)", args: "-email player@example.com -server 783",
			seed:        map[string]string{".lastwar_goclient_device_id": "dev_n3d", ".lastwar_goclient_username": "guest-1"},
			wantLog:     []string{"this device already logged in as a guest", "device bound by email verification"},

			seed:        map[string]string{".lastwar_goclient_device_id": "dev_n3d", ".lastwar_goclient_gameuid": "uid-guest"},
			wantLog:     []string{"this device already logged in as a guest", "device bound by email verification"},
			wantGameUid: "uid-783", wantLoginKey: "lk-role-783", wantZone: lookupZone, wantDeviceID: "dev_n3d"},
		{name: "no role on -server", args: "-email player@example.com -server 999", wantCode: 1,
			wantLog: []string{"no role on server 999", "fresh LASTWAR_STATE_DIR"},
			noLog:   []string{"own-device bootstrap failed", "wrote own-device session config"}},
		{name: "code refused", args: "-email player@example.com -server 783", pushMode: "error", wantCode: 2,

			noLog:   []string{"own-device bootstrap failed", "wrote own-device session config"}},

			wantLog: []string{"the server ended this session"},
			noLog:   []string{"own-device bootstrap failed", "wrote own-device session config"}},
		{name: "device identity unreadable", args: "-email player@example.com",
			seed: map[string]string{".lastwar_goclient_device_id": "<dir>"}, wantCode: 1,
			wantLog: []string{"load device identity failed"},
			noLog:   []string{"step 6: request email verify code", "wrote own-device session config"}},
		{name: "plain -email -server", args: "-email player@example.com -server 783", plain: true,
			wantLog:     []string{"binding the role on the requested server"},
			wantGameUid: "uid-783", wantLoginKey: "lk-role-783"},
	} {
		t.Run(c.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			home := t.TempDir()
			env := []string{"LASTWAR_TEST_HOME=" + home, "LASTWAR_TEST_ARGS=" + c.args}
			for name, v := range c.seed {
				if v == "<dir>" {
					// A directory where the state file should be: the read fails.
					if err := os.Mkdir(filepath.Join(home, name), 0o700); err != nil {
						t.Fatal(err)
					}
					continue
				}
				if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(home, name), []byte(v), 0o600); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			}
			if c.seed[".lastwar_goclient_loginkey"] != "" {
				env = append(env, "LASTWAR_TEST_BOUND=1")
			}
			if c.plain {
				env = append(env, "LASTWAR_TEST_PLAIN=1")
			}
			if c.pushMode != "" {
				env = append(env, "LASTWAR_TEST_PUSH_MODE="+c.pushMode)
			}
			code, stderr := runRefreshHelper(t, "TestMainOwnDeviceSessionWithEmail", env...)
			if code != c.wantCode {
				t.Fatalf("exit code = %d, want %d; stderr=%s", code, c.wantCode, stderr)
			}
			if c.wantCode == 0 && !strings.Contains(stderr, "run returned") {
				t.Fatalf("Run() didn't return cleanly; stderr=%s", stderr)
			}
			for _, want := range c.wantLog {
				if !strings.Contains(stderr, want) {
					t.Errorf("log lacks %q; stderr=%s", want, stderr)
				}
			}
			for _, not := range c.noLog {
				if strings.Contains(stderr, not) {
					t.Errorf("log has %q; stderr=%s", not, stderr)
				}
			}
			state := func(name string) string {
				b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(home, name))
				if err != nil {
					return ""
				}
				return strings.TrimSpace(string(b))
			}
			if got := state(".lastwar_goclient_loginkey"); got != c.wantLoginKey {
				t.Errorf("persisted loginKey = %q, want %q", got, c.wantLoginKey)
			}
			if c.wantGameUid != "" {
				if got := state(".lastwar_goclient_gameuid"); got != c.wantGameUid {
					t.Errorf("persisted gameUid = %q, want %q", got, c.wantGameUid)
				}
			}
			cfgPath := filepath.Join(home, "own.json")
			if c.wantZone == "" {
				if _, err := os.Stat(cfgPath); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
					t.Errorf("a session config was written (stat err %v)", err)
				}
			} else {
				cfg := readSessionConfig(t, cfgPath)
				if cfg.AccessToken != "at-own" || cfg.RefreshToken != "rt-own" || cfg.GameUid != c.wantGameUid || cfg.Zone != c.wantZone {
					t.Errorf("session config: at=%q rt=%q gameUid=%q zone=%q, want at-own rt-own %s %s", cfg.AccessToken, cfg.RefreshToken, cfg.GameUid, cfg.Zone, c.wantGameUid, c.wantZone)
				}
				if cfg.DeviceID == "" || (c.wantDeviceID != "" && cfg.DeviceID != c.wantDeviceID) || cfg.IOSMode {
					t.Errorf("session config: deviceId=%q iosMode=%v, want this device (%q), Android", cfg.DeviceID, cfg.IOSMode, c.wantDeviceID)
				}
			}
			for _, secret := range []string{"lk-account", "lk-role-783", "at-own", "rt-own"} {
				if strings.Contains(stderr, secret) {
					t.Errorf("log contains %q; stderr=%s", secret, stderr)
				}
			}
			// The code is six digits, which a timestamp's fraction can contain, so only a logged
			// value counts.
			if strings.Contains(stderr, `"123456"`) || strings.Contains(stderr, ":123456") {
				t.Errorf("log contains the verification code; stderr=%s", stderr)
			}
		})
	}
}

}
```

`internal/app/main_refresh_test.go`:

```go
package app

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"lastwar-client/internal/auth"
	"lastwar-client/internal/gsl"
	"lastwar-client/internal/session"
	"lastwar-client/internal/sfs"
	"lastwar-client/internal/shumei"
	"lastwar-client/internal/testutil"
	"log/slog"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"testing/synctest"
	"time"
)

// The token pair a refresh in these tests hands out.
const (
	refreshedAt     = "at-new"
	refreshedRt     = "rt-new"
	refreshedAtTime = 1791900000
	refreshedRtTime = 1791900001
)

// refreshReply is a GSL opt=refresh reply: the role's server plus a fresh at and a rotated rt.
func refreshReply() gsl.LoginServerListRespon {
	r := lookupReply()
	r.At = &gsl.LoginToken{Token: refreshedAt, Time: gsl.FlexString(strconv.Itoa(refreshedAtTime))}
	r.Rt = &gsl.LoginToken{Token: refreshedRt, Time: gsl.FlexString(strconv.Itoa(refreshedRtTime))}
	return r
}

// loginAts records the p.at of every Login a tokenCheckingServer reads.
type loginAts struct {
	mu  sync.Mutex
	ats []string
}

func (l *loginAts) add(at string) {
	l.mu.Lock()
	defer l.mu.Unlock()
	l.ats = append(l.ats, at)
}

func (l *loginAts) get() []string {
	l.mu.Lock()
	defer l.mu.Unlock()
	return append([]string(nil), l.ats...)
}

// tokenCheckingServer accepts a Login carrying the good access token (then sends init) and rejects
// any other with ec=28/E011, the way the game server treats a superseded token.
func tokenCheckingServer(good string, seen *loginAts) func(*session.GameConn) {
	return func(server *session.GameConn) {
		env, err := server.ReadEnvelope()
		if err != nil {
			return
		}
		at := ""
		if pv, ok := env.Content.Get("p"); ok {
			if pObj, ok := pv.Val.(*sfs.SFSObject); ok {
				at = pObj.GetString("at")
			}
		}
		seen.add(at)
		resp := sfs.NewSFSObject()
		if at != good {
			resp.PutValue("ep", sfs.SFSValue{Type: 16, Val: []string{"E011"}}) // 16 = UTF_STRING_ARRAY
			resp.PutShort("ec", 28)
			_ = server.SendEnvelope(session.ControllerSystem, session.ActionLogin, resp)
			return
		}
		resp.PutBool("success", true)
		if err := server.SendEnvelope(session.ControllerSystem, session.ActionLogin, resp); err != nil {
			return
		}
		_ = server.SendExtension("init", sfs.NewSFSObject())
	}
}

// writeSessionConfig writes cfg to a fresh path and returns it.
func writeSessionConfig(t *testing.T, cfg SessionConfig) string {
	t.Helper()
	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "session.json")
	if err := SaveSessionConfig(&cfg, path); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("write session config: %v", err)
	}
	return path
}

// wantRefreshedTokens checks that the session config at path holds the refreshed pair.
func wantRefreshedTokens(t *testing.T, path string) SessionConfig {
	t.Helper()
	cfg := readSessionConfig(t, path)
	if cfg.AccessToken != refreshedAt || cfg.RefreshToken != refreshedRt {
		t.Errorf("persisted at/rt = %q/%q, want %q/%q", cfg.AccessToken, cfg.RefreshToken, refreshedAt, refreshedRt)
	}
	if cfg.AccessTokenTime != refreshedAtTime || cfg.RefreshTokenTime != refreshedRtTime {
		t.Errorf("persisted at.time/rt.time = %d/%d, want %d/%d", cfg.AccessTokenTime, cfg.RefreshTokenTime, refreshedAtTime, refreshedRtTime)
	}
	return cfg
}

// TestRunCrossServerTestRefreshesAfterE011: a Login rejected with E011 is followed by one GSL
// opt=refresh with the session config's refresh token and one more Login with the fresh access
// token, as in the real client, and the new pair lands in the session config.
func TestRunCrossServerTestRefreshesAfterE011(t *testing.T) {
	t.Setenv("HOME", t.TempDir())
	client := testutil.UseInMemoryGSL(t, refreshReply())
	gslCalls := countGetServerList(client)
	var seen loginAts
	dial, dialed := recordingDial(map[string]func(*session.GameConn){"10.0.0.1:10783": tokenCheckingServer(refreshedAt, &seen)})
	features := map[string]bool{"radar": true}
	cfgPath := writeSessionConfig(t, SessionConfig{
		IP: "10.0.0.1", Port: lookupPort, Zone: lookupZone, GameUid: lookupGameUid,
		AccessToken: "at-old", RefreshToken: "rt-old", Features: features,
	})

	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		now := time.Now().Unix()
		runCrossServerTest(crossServerTestOpts{
			ip: "10.0.0.1", port: lookupPort, zone: lookupZone, gameUid: lookupGameUid,
			at: "at-old", refreshTok: "rt-old", accessTokTime: now - 3600, refreshTokTime: now - 3600,
			features: features, configSavePath: cfgPath, httpClient: client, dialGame: dial,
		})
		synctest.Wait()
	})

	if got, want := seen.get(), []string{"at-old", refreshedAt}; fmt.Sprint(got) != fmt.Sprint(want) {
		t.Errorf("Login access tokens = %v, want %v", got, want)
	}
	if n := gslCalls(); n != 1 {
		t.Errorf("getserverlist requests = %d, want 1 (the refresh)", n)
	}
	if got := dialed(); len(got) != 2 {
		t.Errorf("dialed %v, want the configured server twice", got)
	}
	cfg := wantRefreshedTokens(t, cfgPath)
	if cfg.IP != "10.0.0.1" || cfg.Port != lookupPort || !cfg.Features["radar"] {
		t.Errorf("the save lost other fields: ip=%q port=%d features=%v", cfg.IP, cfg.Port, cfg.Features)
	}
}

// TestRunCrossServerTestRefreshesBeforeLogin: an access token whose at.time is 30 days old, or one
// that is missing, is refreshed before the Login (gsl.ChooseOpt), so the Login goes out once, with
// the fresh token.
func TestRunCrossServerTestRefreshesBeforeLogin(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		name string
		at   string
		age  time.Duration
	}{
		{"30 days old", "at-old", 30 * 24 * time.Hour},
		{"missing", "", time.Hour},
	}
	for _, c := range cases {
		t.Run(c.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			t.Setenv("HOME", t.TempDir())
			client := testutil.UseInMemoryGSL(t, refreshReply())
			gslCalls := countGetServerList(client)
			var seen loginAts
			dial, _ := recordingDial(map[string]func(*session.GameConn){"10.0.0.1:10783": tokenCheckingServer(refreshedAt, &seen)})
			cfgPath := writeSessionConfig(t, SessionConfig{IP: "10.0.0.1", Port: lookupPort, Zone: lookupZone, GameUid: lookupGameUid, AccessToken: c.at, RefreshToken: "rt-old"})

			synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
				runCrossServerTest(crossServerTestOpts{
					ip: "10.0.0.1", port: lookupPort, zone: lookupZone, gameUid: lookupGameUid,
					at: c.at, refreshTok: "rt-old", accessTokTime: time.Now().Add(-c.age).Unix(),
					configSavePath: cfgPath, httpClient: client, dialGame: dial,
				})
				synctest.Wait()
			})

			if got := seen.get(); fmt.Sprint(got) != fmt.Sprint([]string{refreshedAt}) {
				t.Errorf("Login access tokens = %v, want only the refreshed one", got)
			}
			if n := gslCalls(); n != 1 {
				t.Errorf("getserverlist requests = %d, want 1 (the refresh)", n)
			}
			wantRefreshedTokens(t, cfgPath)
		})
	}
}

// TestRunCrossServerTestFreshTokenNeedsNoRefresh: a working access token younger than 30 days is

func TestRunCrossServerTestFreshTokenNeedsNoRefresh(t *testing.T) {

// TestRunCrossServerTestSaveBackKeepsRefreshToken: a server-address save-back rewrites the session
// config from scratch, and used to drop refreshToken and both token times, stranding the device's
// refresh token after a server lookup or a redirect.
func TestRunCrossServerTestSaveBackKeepsRefreshToken(t *testing.T) {
	t.Setenv("HOME", t.TempDir())
	client := testutil.UseInMemoryGSL(t, lookupReply())
	dial, _ := recordingDial(nil)
	cfgPath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "session.json")
	var atTime int64

	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		atTime = time.Now().Add(-time.Hour).Unix()
		runCrossServerTest(crossServerTestOpts{
			zone: lookupZone, gameUid: lookupGameUid, at: "at-1",
			refreshTok: "rt-1", accessTokTime: atTime, refreshTokTime: atTime - 1,
			configSavePath: cfgPath, httpClient: client, dialGame: dial,
		})
		synctest.Wait()
	})

	cfg := readSessionConfig(t, cfgPath)
	if cfg.IP != lookupGateways {
		t.Fatalf("persisted ip %q, want the looked-up %q (the save-back didn't run)", cfg.IP, lookupGateways)
	}
	if cfg.AccessToken != "at-1" || cfg.RefreshToken != "rt-1" || cfg.AccessTokenTime != atTime || cfg.RefreshTokenTime != atTime-1 {
		t.Errorf("save-back tokens: at=%q rt=%q at.time=%d rt.time=%d, want at-1 rt-1 %d %d",
			cfg.AccessToken, cfg.RefreshToken, cfg.AccessTokenTime, cfg.RefreshTokenTime, atTime, atTime-1)
	}
}

// runRefreshHelper re-executes the test binary to run name's helper branch, for paths where
// runCrossServerTest exits the process, and returns the exit code and stderr.
func runRefreshHelper(t *testing.T, name string, env ...string) (int, string) {
	t.Helper()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 2*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, os.Args[0], "-test.run=^"+name+"$")
	cmd.Env = append(append(os.Environ(), "LASTWAR_TEST_HELPER_PROCESS=1"), env...)
	var stderr bytes.Buffer
	cmd.Stderr = &stderr
	err := cmd.Run()
	if err == nil {
		return 0, stderr.String()
	}
	exitErr, ok := err.(*exec.ExitError)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("subprocess did not run: %v; stderr=%s", err, stderr.String())
	}
	return exitErr.ExitCode(), stderr.String()
}

// TestRunCrossServerTestRefreshSavedBeforeLogin: the refreshed pair is in the session config even
// when the Login after the refresh fails, so a rotated refresh token is never lost. The session
// config's other fields stay as they were on disk.
func TestRunCrossServerTestRefreshSavedBeforeLogin(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_HELPER_PROCESS") == "1" {
		t.Setenv("HOME", t.TempDir())
		client := testutil.UseInMemoryGSL(t, refreshReply())
		var seen loginAts
		dial, _ := recordingDial(map[string]func(*session.GameConn){"10.0.0.1:10783": tokenCheckingServer("never", &seen)})
		runCrossServerTest(crossServerTestOpts{
			ip: "10.0.0.1", port: lookupPort, zone: lookupZone, gameUid: lookupGameUid,
			at: "at-old", refreshTok: "rt-old", configSavePath: os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_CFG"), httpClient: client, dialGame: dial,
		})
		return
	}
	cfgPath := writeSessionConfig(t, SessionConfig{
		IP: "10.0.0.1", Port: lookupPort, Zone: lookupZone, GameUid: lookupGameUid,
		AccessToken: "at-old", RefreshToken: "rt-old", Features: map[string]bool{"radar": true}, DuelPolicy: map[string]string{"radar": "always"},
	})
	code, stderr := runRefreshHelper(t, "TestRunCrossServerTestRefreshSavedBeforeLogin", "LASTWAR_TEST_CFG="+cfgPath)
	if code != 2 {
		t.Errorf("exit code = %d, want 2; stderr=%s", code, stderr)
	}
	cfg := wantRefreshedTokens(t, cfgPath)
	if !cfg.Features["radar"] || cfg.DuelPolicy["radar"] != "always" || cfg.IP != "10.0.0.1" {
		t.Errorf("the token save lost other fields: %+v", struct {
			IP       string
			Features map[string]bool
			Duel     map[string]string
		}{cfg.IP, cfg.Features, cfg.DuelPolicy})
	}
	if !strings.Contains(stderr, "rejected even after a GSL refresh") {
		t.Errorf("want the after-refresh E011 message; stderr=%s", stderr)
	}
	if strings.Count(stderr, "refreshing the access token") != 1 {
		t.Errorf("want exactly one refresh (no loop); stderr=%s", stderr)
	}
	// The subprocess logs through slog's text handler, which doesn't quote values.
	for _, secret := range []string{"at-old", "rt-old", refreshedAt, refreshedRt} {
		if strings.Contains(stderr, secret) {
			t.Errorf("log contains token %q; stderr=%s", secret, stderr)
		}
	}
}

// TestRunCrossServerTestRefreshRejectedExits2: GSL code 211 on the refresh after an E011 means the
// device's credentials are gone, so the run exits 2 with the re-auth message and saves nothing.
func TestRunCrossServerTestRefreshRejectedExits2(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_HELPER_PROCESS") == "1" {
		t.Setenv("HOME", t.TempDir())
		client := testutil.UseInMemoryGSL(t, gsl.LoginServerListRespon{Code: "211"})
		var seen loginAts
		dial, _ := recordingDial(map[string]func(*session.GameConn){"10.0.0.1:10783": tokenCheckingServer("never", &seen)})
		runCrossServerTest(crossServerTestOpts{
			ip: "10.0.0.1", port: lookupPort, zone: lookupZone, gameUid: lookupGameUid,
			at: "at-old", refreshTok: "rt-old", configSavePath: os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_CFG"), httpClient: client, dialGame: dial,
		})
		return
	}
	cfgPath := writeSessionConfig(t, SessionConfig{IP: "10.0.0.1", Port: lookupPort, Zone: lookupZone, GameUid: lookupGameUid, AccessToken: "at-old", RefreshToken: "rt-old"})
	code, stderr := runRefreshHelper(t, "TestRunCrossServerTestRefreshRejectedExits2", "LASTWAR_TEST_CFG="+cfgPath)
	if code != 2 {
		t.Errorf("exit code = %d, want 2; stderr=%s", code, stderr)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(stderr, "GSL rejected this device's credentials") {
		t.Errorf("want the re-auth message; stderr=%s", stderr)
	}
	if cfg := readSessionConfig(t, cfgPath); cfg.AccessToken != "at-old" || cfg.RefreshToken != "rt-old" {
		t.Errorf("a rejected refresh changed the saved tokens: at=%q rt=%q", cfg.AccessToken, cfg.RefreshToken)
	}
}

// TestMainUsesSessionConfigRefreshToken runs Run() end to end. The fake GSL lists the fake game
// server, so a config needs no address of its own.
//   - A config holding only a refresh token (no address, no access token) selects the reconnect by
//     itself, refreshes (opt=refresh), logs in with the fresh token, and saves the pair.
//   - A config whose accessTokenTime is 31 days old refreshes before the Login.
//   - An explicit -cs-at isn't judged by the config's accessTokenTime: it is used as given.
//   - With -cs-deviceid, the config's refresh token (bound to the config's device) is left alone.
func TestMainUsesSessionConfigRefreshToken(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_HELPER_PROCESS") == "1" {
		t.Setenv("HOME", t.TempDir())
		var seen loginAts
		addr := session.StartFakeGameServer(t, tokenCheckingServer(os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_GOOD"), &seen))
		host, port := testutil.SplitHostPortInt(t, addr)
		reply := refreshReply()
		if os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_NO_RT") != "" {
			reply = noRtReply()
		}
		reply.ServerList = []gsl.LoginServerInfo{{ID: "783", IP: gsl.FlexString(host), Port: testutil.FlexPort(port), Zone: lookupZone, GameUid: lookupGameUid}}
		testutil.UseFakeGSLServer(t, testutil.NewFakeGSLServer(t, reply))
		cfgPath := os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_CFG")
		if os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_SET_ADDR") == "1" {
			cfg := readSessionConfig(t, cfgPath)
			cfg.IP, cfg.Port = host, port
			if err := SaveSessionConfig(&cfg, cfgPath); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
		os.Args = append([]string{"lastwar-client", "-config", cfgPath}, strings.Fields(os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_ARGS"))...)
		Run()
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "logins=%v\n", seen.get())
		return
	}

	stale := time.Now().Add(-31 * 24 * time.Hour).Unix()
	for _, c := range []struct {
		name       string
		cfg        SessionConfig
		env        []string
		wantCode   int
		wantLogins string
		refresh    bool
	}{
		{"refresh token only, no address",
			SessionConfig{Zone: lookupZone, GameUid: lookupGameUid, DeviceID: "dev_n3d", RefreshToken: "rt-old"},
			[]string{"LASTWAR_TEST_GOOD=" + refreshedAt}, 0, "[" + refreshedAt + "]", true},
		{"30-day-old accessTokenTime",
			SessionConfig{Zone: lookupZone, GameUid: lookupGameUid, DeviceID: "dev_n3d", AccessToken: "at-old", AccessTokenTime: stale, RefreshToken: "rt-old"},
			[]string{"LASTWAR_TEST_GOOD=" + refreshedAt, "LASTWAR_TEST_SET_ADDR=1"}, 0, "[" + refreshedAt + "]", true},
		// The live reply shape (no rt): the config's refresh token and its time come through the
		// run and are saved back unchanged.
		{"30-day-old accessTokenTime, reply without rt",
			SessionConfig{Zone: lookupZone, GameUid: lookupGameUid, DeviceID: "dev_n3d", AccessToken: "at-old", AccessTokenTime: stale, RefreshToken: "rt-old", RefreshTokenTime: 42},
			[]string{"LASTWAR_TEST_GOOD=" + refreshedAt, "LASTWAR_TEST_SET_ADDR=1", "LASTWAR_TEST_NO_RT=1"}, 0, "[" + refreshedAt + "]", true},
		{"explicit -cs-at ignores the config's accessTokenTime",
			SessionConfig{Zone: lookupZone, GameUid: lookupGameUid, DeviceID: "dev_n3d", AccessToken: "at-old", AccessTokenTime: stale, RefreshToken: "rt-old"},
			[]string{"LASTWAR_TEST_GOOD=at-explicit", "LASTWAR_TEST_SET_ADDR=1", "LASTWAR_TEST_ARGS=-cs-at at-explicit"}, 0, "[at-explicit]", false},
		{"-cs-deviceid ignores the config's refresh token",
			SessionConfig{Zone: lookupZone, GameUid: lookupGameUid, DeviceID: "dev_n3d", RefreshToken: "rt-old", AccessToken: "at-old"},
			[]string{"LASTWAR_TEST_GOOD=" + refreshedAt, "LASTWAR_TEST_SET_ADDR=1", "LASTWAR_TEST_ARGS=-cs-deviceid other_n3d"}, 2, "", false},
	} {
		t.Run(c.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			cfgPath := writeSessionConfig(t, c.cfg)
			code, stderr := runRefreshHelper(t, "TestMainUsesSessionConfigRefreshToken", append([]string{"LASTWAR_TEST_CFG=" + cfgPath}, c.env...)...)
			if code != c.wantCode {
				t.Fatalf("exit code = %d, want %d; stderr=%s", code, c.wantCode, stderr)
			}
			if c.wantLogins != "" && !strings.Contains(stderr, "logins="+c.wantLogins) {
				t.Errorf("want logins=%s; stderr=%s", c.wantLogins, stderr)
			}
			if got := strings.Contains(stderr, `"opt":"refresh"`); got != c.refresh {
				t.Errorf("refreshed = %v, want %v; stderr=%s", got, c.refresh, stderr)
			}
			switch {
			case c.refresh && c.cfg.RefreshTokenTime != 0:
				cfg := readSessionConfig(t, cfgPath)
				if cfg.AccessToken != refreshedAt || cfg.RefreshToken != "rt-old" || cfg.RefreshTokenTime != 42 {
					t.Errorf("at=%q rt=%q rt.time=%d, want %s and the kept rt-old/42", cfg.AccessToken, cfg.RefreshToken, cfg.RefreshTokenTime, refreshedAt)
				}
			case c.refresh:
				wantRefreshedTokens(t, cfgPath)
			}
		})
	}
}

// TestSaveRefreshedTokensKeepsOtherFields: only the four token fields change on disk.
func TestSaveRefreshedTokensKeepsOtherFields(t *testing.T) {
	in := SessionConfig{IP: "h", Port: 1, Zone: "APS1", GameUid: "uid-1", DeviceID: "dev", ShumeiBoxId: "box",
		AccessToken: "at-old", RefreshToken: "rt-old", IOSMode: true, AppVersion: "1.0.364", VersionCode: "1892",
		Features: map[string]bool{"radar": true}}
	path := writeSessionConfig(t, in)
	saveRefreshedTokens(path, "dev", auth.Tokens{AccessTok: refreshedAt, RefreshTok: refreshedRt, AccessTokTime: refreshedAtTime, RefreshTokTime: refreshedRtTime})

	got := wantRefreshedTokens(t, path)
	got.AccessToken, got.RefreshToken, got.AccessTokenTime, got.RefreshTokenTime = in.AccessToken, in.RefreshToken, 0, 0
	gotJSON, _ := json.Marshal(got)
	wantJSON, _ := json.Marshal(in)
	if !bytes.Equal(gotJSON, wantJSON) {
		t.Errorf("other fields changed:\n got %s\nwant %s", gotJSON, wantJSON)
	}
}

// TestSaveRefreshedTokensRefusesAnotherDevicesConfig: tokens issued to one device aren't saved into
// a session config made for another (a -cs-rt run under -cs-deviceid), which would leave the
// config's device with tokens it can't use. A config without a deviceId takes its owner from
// shumeiInstall, and one with neither accepts them.
func TestSaveRefreshedTokensRefusesAnotherDevicesConfig(t *testing.T) {
	tokens := auth.Tokens{AccessTok: refreshedAt, RefreshTok: refreshedRt, AccessTokTime: refreshedAtTime, RefreshTokTime: refreshedRtTime}
	for _, c := range []struct {
		name      string
		cfg       SessionConfig
		runDevice string
		wantSaved bool
	}{
		{"same device", SessionConfig{DeviceID: "dev-a"}, "dev-a", true},
		{"another device", SessionConfig{DeviceID: "dev-a"}, "dev-b", false},
		{"owner from shumeiInstall", SessionConfig{ShumeiInstall: shumei.Install{DeviceID: "dev-a"}}, "dev-b", false},
		{"no owner", SessionConfig{}, "dev-b", true},
	} {
		t.Run(c.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			c.cfg.AccessToken, c.cfg.RefreshToken = "at-old", "rt-old"
			path := writeSessionConfig(t, c.cfg)
			saveRefreshedTokens(path, c.runDevice, tokens)
			got := readSessionConfig(t, path)
			if saved := got.AccessToken == refreshedAt; saved != c.wantSaved {
				t.Errorf("saved = %v, want %v (at=%q rt=%q)", saved, c.wantSaved, got.AccessToken, got.RefreshToken)
			}
			if !c.wantSaved && (got.AccessToken != "at-old" || got.RefreshToken != "rt-old") {
				t.Errorf("a refused save changed the tokens: at=%q rt=%q", got.AccessToken, got.RefreshToken)
			}
		})
	}
}

// TestRunCrossServerTestRefreshFailureAfterE011Exits1: a refresh after E011 that fails for any
// reason but 211/212 (here GSL code 500) says nothing about the session, so the run exits 1, not
// the exit-2 "session is stale" code, without the "bind the device again" message, and saves
// nothing.
func TestRunCrossServerTestRefreshFailureAfterE011Exits1(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_HELPER_PROCESS") == "1" {
		t.Setenv("HOME", t.TempDir())
		client := testutil.UseInMemoryGSL(t, gsl.LoginServerListRespon{Code: "500"})
		var seen loginAts
		dial, _ := recordingDial(map[string]func(*session.GameConn){"10.0.0.1:10783": tokenCheckingServer("never", &seen)})
		runCrossServerTest(crossServerTestOpts{
			ip: "10.0.0.1", port: lookupPort, zone: lookupZone, gameUid: lookupGameUid,
			at: "at-old", refreshTok: "rt-old", configSavePath: os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_CFG"), httpClient: client, dialGame: dial,
		})
		return
	}
	cfgPath := writeSessionConfig(t, SessionConfig{IP: "10.0.0.1", Port: lookupPort, Zone: lookupZone, GameUid: lookupGameUid, AccessToken: "at-old", RefreshToken: "rt-old"})
	code, stderr := runRefreshHelper(t, "TestRunCrossServerTestRefreshFailureAfterE011Exits1", "LASTWAR_TEST_CFG="+cfgPath)
	if code != 1 {
		t.Errorf("exit code = %d, want 1; stderr=%s", code, stderr)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(stderr, "the next run will try again") || strings.Contains(stderr, "bind the device again") {
		t.Errorf("want the retry message and not the re-bind one; stderr=%s", stderr)
	}
	if cfg := readSessionConfig(t, cfgPath); cfg.AccessToken != "at-old" || cfg.RefreshToken != "rt-old" {
		t.Errorf("a failed refresh changed the saved tokens: at=%q rt=%q", cfg.AccessToken, cfg.RefreshToken)
	}
}

// TestRunCrossServerTestCsRtSavesRefreshState: a -cs-rt refresh records the rt that worked (or the
// one the reply rotated it to) and at.time, so the session config can refresh on its own later.
func TestRunCrossServerTestCsRtSavesRefreshState(t *testing.T) {
	for _, c := range []struct {
		name      string
		reply     gsl.LoginServerListRespon
		wantRt    string
		wantRtTim int64
	}{
		{"rotated", refreshReply(), refreshedRt, refreshedRtTime},
		{"not rotated", func() gsl.LoginServerListRespon { r := refreshReply(); r.Rt = nil; return r }(), "rt-flag", 0},
	} {
		t.Run(c.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			t.Setenv("HOME", t.TempDir())
			client := testutil.UseInMemoryGSL(t, c.reply)
			var seen loginAts
			dial, _ := recordingDial(map[string]func(*session.GameConn){"gw-a.example:10783": tokenCheckingServer(refreshedAt, &seen)})
			cfgPath := writeSessionConfig(t, SessionConfig{Zone: lookupZone, GameUid: lookupGameUid, AccessToken: "at-old"})

			synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
				runCrossServerTest(crossServerTestOpts{
					zone: lookupZone, gameUid: lookupGameUid, at: "at-old", rt: "rt-flag",
					configSavePath: cfgPath, httpClient: client, dialGame: dial,
				})
				synctest.Wait()
			})

			cfg := readSessionConfig(t, cfgPath)
			if cfg.AccessToken != refreshedAt || cfg.AccessTokenTime != refreshedAtTime {
				t.Errorf("at/at.time = %q/%d, want %q/%d", cfg.AccessToken, cfg.AccessTokenTime, refreshedAt, refreshedAtTime)
			}
			if cfg.RefreshToken != c.wantRt || cfg.RefreshTokenTime != c.wantRtTim {
				t.Errorf("rt/rt.time = %q/%d, want %q/%d", cfg.RefreshToken, cfg.RefreshTokenTime, c.wantRt, c.wantRtTim)
			}
		})
	}
}

// TestRunCrossServerTestWarnsWhenRefreshedTokenStillStale: a refresh that hands back an at.time 30
// days old (GSL returned the current at with its original time, live, eight days in) means every
// run will refresh again; the run logs that once at Warn and still logs in.
func TestRunCrossServerTestWarnsWhenRefreshedTokenStillStale(t *testing.T) {
	t.Setenv("HOME", t.TempDir())
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	orig := slog.Default()
	slog.SetDefault(slog.New(slog.NewTextHandler(&buf, nil)))
	defer slog.SetDefault(orig)
	var seen loginAts
	dial, _ := recordingDial(map[string]func(*session.GameConn){"10.0.0.1:10783": tokenCheckingServer(refreshedAt, &seen)})

	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		old := time.Now().Add(-31 * 24 * time.Hour).Unix()
		reply := refreshReply()
		reply.At.Time = gsl.FlexString(strconv.FormatInt(old, 10))
		client := testutil.UseInMemoryGSL(t, reply)
		runCrossServerTest(crossServerTestOpts{
			ip: "10.0.0.1", port: lookupPort, zone: lookupZone, gameUid: lookupGameUid,
			at: "at-old", refreshTok: "rt-old", accessTokTime: old, httpClient: client, dialGame: dial,
		})
		synctest.Wait()
	})

	if got := seen.get(); fmt.Sprint(got) != fmt.Sprint([]string{refreshedAt}) {
		t.Errorf("Login access tokens = %v, want [%s]", got, refreshedAt)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(buf.String(), "still 30 days old") {
		t.Errorf("want the still-stale warning:\n%s", buf.String())
	}
}

// noRtReply is the refresh reply shape seen live: a fresh at and no rt.
func noRtReply() gsl.LoginServerListRespon {
	r := refreshReply()
	r.Rt = nil
	return r
}

// TestRunCrossServerTestRefreshWithoutRtKeepsTheRefreshToken: live, opt=refresh returned an at and
// no rt. The config's refresh token and its time must survive that, after an E011 and before a
// Login alike, or the feature works exactly once.
func TestRunCrossServerTestRefreshWithoutRtKeepsTheRefreshToken(t *testing.T) {
	for _, c := range []struct {
		name       string
		at         string
		staleAt    bool
		wantLogins []string
	}{
		{"after E011", "at-old", false, []string{"at-old", refreshedAt}},
		{"before the Login", "at-old", true, []string{refreshedAt}},
	} {
		t.Run(c.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			t.Setenv("HOME", t.TempDir())
			client := testutil.UseInMemoryGSL(t, noRtReply())
			var seen loginAts
			dial, _ := recordingDial(map[string]func(*session.GameConn){"10.0.0.1:10783": tokenCheckingServer(refreshedAt, &seen)})
			cfgPath := writeSessionConfig(t, SessionConfig{IP: "10.0.0.1", Port: lookupPort, Zone: lookupZone, GameUid: lookupGameUid, AccessToken: c.at, RefreshToken: "rt-old", RefreshTokenTime: 42})

			synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
				var atTime int64
				if c.staleAt {
					atTime = time.Now().Add(-31 * 24 * time.Hour).Unix()
				}
				runCrossServerTest(crossServerTestOpts{
					ip: "10.0.0.1", port: lookupPort, zone: lookupZone, gameUid: lookupGameUid,
					at: c.at, refreshTok: "rt-old", accessTokTime: atTime, refreshTokTime: 42,
					configSavePath: cfgPath, httpClient: client, dialGame: dial,
				})
				synctest.Wait()
			})

			if got := seen.get(); fmt.Sprint(got) != fmt.Sprint(c.wantLogins) {
				t.Errorf("Login access tokens = %v, want %v", got, c.wantLogins)
			}
			cfg := readSessionConfig(t, cfgPath)
			if cfg.AccessToken != refreshedAt || cfg.AccessTokenTime != refreshedAtTime {
				t.Errorf("at/at.time = %q/%d, want %q/%d", cfg.AccessToken, cfg.AccessTokenTime, refreshedAt, refreshedAtTime)
			}
			if cfg.RefreshToken != "rt-old" || cfg.RefreshTokenTime != 42 {
				t.Errorf("rt/rt.time = %q/%d, want the kept rt-old/42", cfg.RefreshToken, cfg.RefreshTokenTime)
			}
		})
	}
}

// TestRunCrossServerTestRefreshesOncePerRun: a 30-day-old token refreshed before the Login and then
// rejected anyway is not refreshed a second time; the run exits 2 after one refresh.
func TestRunCrossServerTestRefreshesOncePerRun(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_HELPER_PROCESS") == "1" {
		t.Setenv("HOME", t.TempDir())
		client := testutil.UseInMemoryGSL(t, refreshReply())
		var seen loginAts
		dial, _ := recordingDial(map[string]func(*session.GameConn){"10.0.0.1:10783": tokenCheckingServer("never", &seen)})
		runCrossServerTest(crossServerTestOpts{
			ip: "10.0.0.1", port: lookupPort, zone: lookupZone, gameUid: lookupGameUid,
			at: "at-old", refreshTok: "rt-old", accessTokTime: time.Now().Add(-31 * 24 * time.Hour).Unix(),
			configSavePath: os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_CFG"), httpClient: client, dialGame: dial,
		})
		return
	}
	cfgPath := writeSessionConfig(t, SessionConfig{IP: "10.0.0.1", Port: lookupPort, Zone: lookupZone, GameUid: lookupGameUid, AccessToken: "at-old", RefreshToken: "rt-old"})
	code, stderr := runRefreshHelper(t, "TestRunCrossServerTestRefreshesOncePerRun", "LASTWAR_TEST_CFG="+cfgPath)
	if code != 2 {
		t.Errorf("exit code = %d, want 2; stderr=%s", code, stderr)
	}
	if n := strings.Count(stderr, "GSL getserverlist: refreshing the access token"); n != 1 {
		t.Errorf("refreshes = %d, want 1; stderr=%s", n, stderr)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(stderr, "rejected even after a GSL refresh") {
		t.Errorf("want the after-refresh message; stderr=%s", stderr)
	}
}

// TestRunCrossServerTestRefreshBeforeLoginFails: a refresh before the Login that GSL rejects with
// 211 and no access token to fall back on exits 2 with the re-auth message; one that fails for
// another reason while an old access token exists logs in with the old token.
func TestRunCrossServerTestRefreshBeforeLoginFails(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_HELPER_PROCESS") == "1" {
		t.Setenv("HOME", t.TempDir())
		code := os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_GSL_CODE")
		client := testutil.UseInMemoryGSL(t, gsl.LoginServerListRespon{Code: gsl.FlexString(code)})
		var seen loginAts
		dial, _ := recordingDial(map[string]func(*session.GameConn){"10.0.0.1:10783": tokenCheckingServer("at-old", &seen)})
		at, atTime := os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_AT"), time.Now().Add(-31*24*time.Hour).Unix()
		runCrossServerTest(crossServerTestOpts{
			ip: "10.0.0.1", port: lookupPort, zone: lookupZone, gameUid: lookupGameUid,
			at: at, refreshTok: "rt-old", accessTokTime: atTime, httpClient: client, dialGame: dial,
		})
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "logins=%v\n", seen.get())
		return
	}
	t.Run("211, no access token", func(t *testing.T) {
		code, stderr := runRefreshHelper(t, "TestRunCrossServerTestRefreshBeforeLoginFails", "LASTWAR_TEST_GSL_CODE=211", "LASTWAR_TEST_AT=")
		if code != 2 || !strings.Contains(stderr, "GSL rejected this device's credentials") {
			t.Errorf("exit code = %d, want 2 with the re-auth message; stderr=%s", code, stderr)
		}
	})
	t.Run("211, old access token", func(t *testing.T) {
		code, stderr := runRefreshHelper(t, "TestRunCrossServerTestRefreshBeforeLoginFails", "LASTWAR_TEST_GSL_CODE=211", "LASTWAR_TEST_AT=at-old")
		if code != 0 || !strings.Contains(stderr, "logins=[at-old]") || !strings.Contains(stderr, "refresh token is no longer accepted") {
			t.Errorf("exit code = %d, want 0, a Login with the old token, and the bind-again error; stderr=%s", code, stderr)
		}
	})
	t.Run("transient failure, old access token", func(t *testing.T) {
		code, stderr := runRefreshHelper(t, "TestRunCrossServerTestRefreshBeforeLoginFails", "LASTWAR_TEST_GSL_CODE=500", "LASTWAR_TEST_AT=at-old")
		if code != 0 || !strings.Contains(stderr, "logins=[at-old]") || !strings.Contains(stderr, "trying the old access token") {
			t.Errorf("exit code = %d, want 0 and a Login with the old token; stderr=%s", code, stderr)
		}
	})
}

// TestRunCrossServerTestCsRtSavesBeforeAFailedLogin: a -cs-rt refresh saves the rotated rt before
// the Login, so a Login that fails afterwards doesn't lose it.
func TestRunCrossServerTestCsRtSavesBeforeAFailedLogin(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_HELPER_PROCESS") == "1" {
		t.Setenv("HOME", t.TempDir())
		client := testutil.UseInMemoryGSL(t, refreshReply())
		var seen loginAts
		dial, _ := recordingDial(map[string]func(*session.GameConn){"gw-a.example:10783": tokenCheckingServer("never", &seen)})
		runCrossServerTest(crossServerTestOpts{
			zone: lookupZone, gameUid: lookupGameUid, at: "at-old", rt: "rt-flag",
			configSavePath: os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_CFG"), httpClient: client, dialGame: dial,
		})
		return
	}
	cfgPath := writeSessionConfig(t, SessionConfig{Zone: lookupZone, GameUid: lookupGameUid, AccessToken: "at-old"})
	code, stderr := runRefreshHelper(t, "TestRunCrossServerTestCsRtSavesBeforeAFailedLogin", "LASTWAR_TEST_CFG="+cfgPath)
	if code != 2 {
		t.Errorf("exit code = %d, want 2; stderr=%s", code, stderr)
	}
	wantRefreshedTokens(t, cfgPath)
}

// TestRunCrossServerTestRefreshRequest decrypts the refresh this run sends: opt=refresh with the
// config's refresh token, the run's device, zone and gameUid, and the session's platform.
func TestRunCrossServerTestRefreshRequest(t *testing.T) {
	for _, c := range []struct {
		iosMode      bool
		wantPlatform string
	}{{false, gsl.Platform}, {true, "iOS"}} {
		t.Run(c.wantPlatform, func(t *testing.T) {
			t.Setenv("HOME", t.TempDir())
			client, forms := testutil.UseDecryptingGSL(t, refreshReply())
			var seen loginAts
			dial, _ := recordingDial(map[string]func(*session.GameConn){"10.0.0.1:10783": tokenCheckingServer(refreshedAt, &seen)})

			synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
				runCrossServerTest(crossServerTestOpts{
					ip: "10.0.0.1", port: lookupPort, zone: lookupZone, gameUid: lookupGameUid, deviceID: "dev-cfg",
					refreshTok: "rt-old", iosMode: c.iosMode, httpClient: client, dialGame: dial,
				})
				synctest.Wait()
			})

			got := forms()
			if len(got) != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("getserverlist requests = %d, want 1", len(got))
			}
			want := map[string]string{"opt": "refresh", "rt": "rt-old", "uuid": "dev-cfg", "zone": lookupZone, "gameuid": lookupGameUid, "platform": c.wantPlatform}
			for k, v := range want {
				if g := got[0].Get(k); g != v {
					t.Errorf("%s = %q, want %q", k, g, v)
				}
			}
		})
	}
}

// TestRunCrossServerTestCsRtRefreshesOnce: a -cs-rt refresh whose reply still carries a 30-day-old

func TestRunCrossServerTestCsRtRefreshesOnce(t *testing.T) {

		t.Errorf("Login access tokens = %v, want [%s]", got, refreshedAt)
	}
}
```

```go
package app

import (
	"bytes"

// The game server a lookup returns in these tests: the zone's three gateways on its current port.
const (
	lookupGateways = "gw-a.example|gw-b.example|gw-c.example"
	lookupPort     = 10783
	lookupZone     = "APS783"
	lookupGameUid  = "uid-1"
)

func lookupReply() gsl.LoginServerListRespon {
	return gsl.LoginServerListRespon{
		Code: "0",
		ServerList: []gsl.LoginServerInfo{
			{ID: "783", IP: lookupGateways, Port: testutil.FlexPort(lookupPort), Zone: lookupZone, GameUid: lookupGameUid},
		},
	}
}

// countGetServerList wraps client's transport to count getserverlist.php requests.
func countGetServerList(client *http.Client) func() int {
	var mu sync.Mutex
	n := 0
	base := client.Transport
	client.Transport = roundTripFunc(func(r *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
		if strings.HasSuffix(r.URL.Path, "getserverlist.php") {
			mu.Lock()
			n++
			mu.Unlock()
		}
		return base.RoundTrip(r)
	})
	return func() int {
		mu.Lock()
		defer mu.Unlock()
		return n
	}
}

type roundTripFunc func(*http.Request) (*http.Response, error)

func (f roundTripFunc) RoundTrip(r *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) { return f(r) }

// recordingDial serves every address with an in-memory game server: handlers[addr] when present,
// else FakeInitPushServer, and records the addresses dialed. A nil handler refuses the dial the way
// an unreachable gateway does.
func recordingDial(handlers map[string]func(*session.GameConn)) (dial func(string, time.Duration) (*session.GameConn, error), dialed func() []string) {
	var mu sync.Mutex
	var addrs []string
	return func(addr string, timeout time.Duration) (*session.GameConn, error) {
			mu.Lock()
			addrs = append(addrs, addr)
			mu.Unlock()
			handler, ok := handlers[addr]
			if !ok {
				handler = session.FakeInitPushServer(nil)
			} else if handler == nil {
				return nil, &net.OpError{Op: "dial", Net: "tcp", Err: errors.New("connection refused")}
			}
			return session.NewInMemoryGameDial(handler)(addr, timeout)
		}, func() []string {
			mu.Lock()
			defer mu.Unlock()
			return append([]string(nil), addrs...)
		}
}

func readSessionConfig(t *testing.T, path string) SessionConfig {
	t.Helper()
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("session config was not written to %s: %v", path, err)
	}
	var cfg SessionConfig
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &cfg); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("parse persisted session config: %v", err)
	}
	return cfg
}

// TestRunCrossServerTestLooksUpMissingAddress: a session with no ip/port asks GSL getserverlist for
// the role's game server, dials its first gateway, logs in with the zone the lookup named, and
// persists the whole gateway list and port, keeping the configured access token.
func TestRunCrossServerTestLooksUpMissingAddress(t *testing.T) {
	t.Setenv("HOME", t.TempDir())
	client := testutil.UseInMemoryGSL(t, lookupReply())
	lookups := countGetServerList(client)
	zoneSeen := make(chan string, 1)
	dial, dialed := recordingDial(map[string]func(*session.GameConn){
		"gw-a.example:10783": session.FakeInitPushServer(zoneSeen),
	})
	cfgPath := t.TempDir() + "/session.json"

	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		runCrossServerTest(crossServerTestOpts{
			zone: "APS1", gameUid: lookupGameUid, at: "at-1",
			configSavePath: cfgPath, httpClient: client, dialGame: dial,
		})
		synctest.Wait()
	})

	if n := lookups(); n != 1 {
		t.Errorf("getserverlist requests = %d, want 1", n)
	}
	if got := dialed(); len(got) != 1 || got[0] != "gw-a.example:10783" {
		t.Errorf("dialed %v, want [gw-a.example:10783]", got)
	}
	if z := <-zoneSeen; z != lookupZone {
		t.Errorf("Login zone = %q, want the looked-up %q", z, lookupZone)
	}
	cfg := readSessionConfig(t, cfgPath)
	if cfg.IP != lookupGateways || cfg.Port != lookupPort || cfg.Zone != lookupZone {
		t.Errorf("persisted %s %s:%d, want %s %s:%d", cfg.Zone, cfg.IP, cfg.Port, lookupZone, lookupGateways, lookupPort)
	}
	if cfg.AccessToken != "at-1" || cfg.GameUid != lookupGameUid {
		t.Errorf("persisted accessToken/gameUid changed: tokenLen=%d gameUid=%q", len(cfg.AccessToken), cfg.GameUid)
	}
}

// TestRunCrossServerTestDoesNotLookUpAWorkingAddress: a configured address that answers needs no

func TestRunCrossServerTestDoesNotLookUpAWorkingAddress(t *testing.T) {

// TestRunCrossServerTestLooksUpAfterUnreachableAddress: when the configured address refuses every
// dial, or accepts the connection but never answers the Login (the August 2026 port move), one GSL
// lookup finds the current server, the Login is retried there, and the new address is persisted.
func TestRunCrossServerTestLooksUpAfterUnreachableAddress(t *testing.T) {
	cases := map[string]func(*session.GameConn){
		"dial refused":     nil,
		"login unanswered": func(*session.GameConn) {}, // the drain reads the Login and never replies
	}
	for name, stale := range cases {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			t.Setenv("HOME", t.TempDir())
			client := testutil.UseInMemoryGSL(t, lookupReply())
			lookups := countGetServerList(client)
			dial, dialed := recordingDial(map[string]func(*session.GameConn){"10.0.0.1:17783": stale})
			cfgPath := t.TempDir() + "/session.json"

			synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
				runCrossServerTest(crossServerTestOpts{
					ip: "10.0.0.1", port: 17783, zone: lookupZone, gameUid: lookupGameUid, at: "at-1",
					configSavePath: cfgPath, httpClient: client, dialGame: dial,
				})
				synctest.Wait()
			})

			if n := lookups(); n != 1 {
				t.Errorf("getserverlist requests = %d, want 1", n)
			}
			want := []string{"10.0.0.1:17783", "gw-a.example:10783"}
			if got := dialed(); fmt.Sprint(got) != fmt.Sprint(want) {
				t.Errorf("dialed %v, want %v", got, want)
			}
			cfg := readSessionConfig(t, cfgPath)
			if cfg.IP != lookupGateways || cfg.Port != lookupPort {
				t.Errorf("persisted %s:%d, want %s:%d", cfg.IP, cfg.Port, lookupGateways, lookupPort)
			}
		})
	}
}

// TestRunCrossServerTestNoLookupOnTokenRejection: an E011 rejection comes from a server that
// answered, so another address can't help, and a GSL call is the last thing a token problem should
// trigger. The run exits 2 without looking anything up. Re-executes the test binary because
// runCrossServerTest exits the process on this path.
func TestRunCrossServerTestNoLookupOnTokenRejection(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_HELPER_PROCESS") == "1" {
		t.Setenv("HOME", t.TempDir())
		client := testutil.UseInMemoryGSL(t, lookupReply())
		reject := func(server *session.GameConn) {
			if _, err := server.ReadEnvelope(); err != nil {
				return
			}
			resp := sfs.NewSFSObject()
			resp.PutValue("ep", sfs.SFSValue{Type: 16, Val: []string{"E011"}}) // 16 = UTF_STRING_ARRAY
			resp.PutShort("ec", 28)
			_ = server.SendEnvelope(session.ControllerSystem, session.ActionLogin, resp)
		}
		dial, _ := recordingDial(map[string]func(*session.GameConn){"10.0.0.1:17783": reject})
		runCrossServerTest(crossServerTestOpts{
			ip: "10.0.0.1", port: 17783, zone: lookupZone, gameUid: lookupGameUid, at: "at-1",
			httpClient: client, dialGame: dial,
		})
		return
	}

	cmd := exec.Command(os.Args[0], "-test.run=^TestRunCrossServerTestNoLookupOnTokenRejection$")
	cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), "LASTWAR_TEST_HELPER_PROCESS=1")
	var stderr bytes.Buffer
	cmd.Stderr = &stderr
	runErr := cmd.Run()

	exitErr, ok := runErr.(*exec.ExitError)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("subprocess did not fail as expected: err=%v, stderr=%s", runErr, stderr.String())
	}
	if exitErr.ExitCode() != 2 {
		t.Errorf("subprocess exit code = %d, want 2; stderr=%s", exitErr.ExitCode(), stderr.String())
	}
	if strings.Contains(stderr.String(), "GSL getserverlist") {
		t.Errorf("an E011 rejection triggered a GSL lookup; stderr=%s", stderr.String())
	}
}

// TestRunCrossServerTestNoRetryWhenLookupNamesTheSameServer: when GSL lists the very address that
// just failed, a second dial can't help, so the run reports the original error and exits 1 after
// one dial. Re-executes the test binary because runCrossServerTest exits the process on this path.
func TestRunCrossServerTestNoRetryWhenLookupNamesTheSameServer(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_HELPER_PROCESS") == "1" {
		t.Setenv("HOME", t.TempDir())
		client := testutil.UseInMemoryGSL(t, lookupReply())
		// The configured gateways are the looked-up ones in another order, and all refuse.
		runCrossServerTest(crossServerTestOpts{
			ip: "gw-c.example|gw-b.example|gw-a.example", port: lookupPort, zone: lookupZone, gameUid: lookupGameUid, at: "at-1",
			httpClient: client, dialGame: func(addr string, _ time.Duration) (*session.GameConn, error) {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "dial %s\n", addr)
				return nil, &net.OpError{Op: "dial", Net: "tcp", Err: errors.New("connection refused")}
			},
		})
		return
	}

	cmd := exec.Command(os.Args[0], "-test.run=^TestRunCrossServerTestNoRetryWhenLookupNamesTheSameServer$")
	cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), "LASTWAR_TEST_HELPER_PROCESS=1")
	var stderr bytes.Buffer
	cmd.Stderr = &stderr
	runErr := cmd.Run()

	exitErr, ok := runErr.(*exec.ExitError)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("subprocess did not fail as expected: err=%v, stderr=%s", runErr, stderr.String())
	}
	if exitErr.ExitCode() != 1 {
		t.Errorf("subprocess exit code = %d, want 1; stderr=%s", exitErr.ExitCode(), stderr.String())
	}
	log := stderr.String()
	if !strings.Contains(log, "GSL lists the game server that just failed; not retrying") {
		t.Errorf("want the not-retrying warning; stderr=%s", log)
	}
	// One pass over the configured gateways, none after the lookup.
	if n := strings.Count(log, "dial gw-"); n != 3 {
		t.Errorf("dialed %d times, want 3 (one pass over the configured gateways); stderr=%s", n, log)
	}
}

func TestConnectFailed(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		name string
		err  error
		want bool
	}{
		{"dial refused", &net.OpError{Op: "dial", Net: "tcp", Err: errors.New("connection refused")}, true},
		{"every gateway refused", errors.Join(&net.OpError{Op: "dial"}, &net.OpError{Op: "dial"}), true},
		{"login unanswered", session.DeadlineExceededError{}, true},
		{"connection dropped", session.SendStageError{Err: errors.New("broken pipe")}, true},
		{"auth rejected", fmt.Errorf("CROSS-SERVER LOGIN FAILED: %w", session.ErrAuthRejected), false},
		{"token rejected", fmt.Errorf("CROSS-SERVER LOGIN FAILED: %w", session.ErrTokenRejected), false},
		{"kicked", &session.SessionEndedError{Err: session.ErrKicked}, false},
		{"plain error", errors.New("cross-server login: no access token given"), false},
	}
	for _, c := range cases {
		if got := connectFailed(c.err); got != c.want {
			t.Errorf("%s: connectFailed = %v, want %v", c.name, got, c.want)
		}
	}
}

func TestSameGameServer(t *testing.T) {
	srv := auth.GameServer{IP: "a|b", Port: 10783, Zone: "APS783"}
	cases := []struct {
		name string
		ip   string
		port int
		zone string
		want bool
	}{
		{"same", "a|b", 10783, "APS783", true},
		{"same hosts, other order", "b|a", 10783, "APS783", true},
		{"other port", "a|b", 17783, "APS783", false},
		{"other zone", "a|b", 10783, "APS8092", false},
		{"captured IPs vs hostnames", "1.2.3.4|5.6.7.8", 10783, "APS783", false},
	}
	for _, c := range cases {
		if got := sameGameServer(srv, c.ip, c.port, c.zone); got != c.want {
			t.Errorf("%s: sameGameServer = %v, want %v", c.name, got, c.want)
		}
	}
}
```

`internal/app/main_sessionended_test.go`:

```go
package app

import (
	"bytes"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"lastwar-client/internal/gsl"
	"lastwar-client/internal/session"
	"lastwar-client/internal/sfs"
	"lastwar-client/internal/testutil"
)

// readLoginRequest reads envelopes until the client's Login request, skipping its heartbeat pings.
func readLoginRequest(server *session.GameConn) bool {
	for {
		env, err := server.ReadEnvelope()
		if err != nil {
			return false
		}
		if env.Controller == session.ControllerSystem && env.Action == session.ActionLogin {
			return true
		}
	}
}

func sendLoginOK(server *session.GameConn) bool {
	resp := sfs.NewSFSObject()
	resp.PutBool("success", true)
	return server.SendEnvelope(session.ControllerSystem, session.ActionLogin, resp) == nil
}

// sessionEndedServers are fake game servers that each end the session with a terminal push at a
// different point of a cross-server run.
var sessionEndedServers = map[string]func(*session.GameConn){
	// Kicked while FetchInit waits for the init push.
	"kicked-during-init": func(server *session.GameConn) {
		if !readLoginRequest(server) || !sendLoginOK(server) {
			return
		}
		kick := sfs.NewSFSObject()
		kick.PutUtfString("errorCode", "E100083")
		_ = server.SendExtension("push.user.off", kick)
	},
	// init.error in place of the Login response.
	"init-error-at-login": func(server *session.GameConn) {
		if !readLoginRequest(server) {
			return
		}
		_ = server.SendExtension("init.error", nil)
	},
	// Maintenance stop answering the first collect request.
	"server-stop-during-collect": func(server *session.GameConn) {
		if !readLoginRequest(server) || !sendLoginOK(server) {
			return
		}
		if server.SendExtension("init", sfs.NewSFSObject()) != nil {
			return
		}
		if _, err := session.ReadNextExtension(server); err != nil {
			return
		}
		_ = server.SendExtension("push.server.stop", nil)
		for {
			if _, err := server.ReadEnvelope(); err != nil {
				return
			}
		}
	},
}

// TestRunCrossServerTestExitsCode3WhenServerEndsSession covers MASTER.md 5.1 #2 end to end: a
// terminal push at login, during the init wait, or during -collect makes the run exit with code 3
// and the "ended this session" log line, instead of the generic 1 (or carrying on). Each case runs
// runCrossServerTest in a re-exec'd subprocess, since it calls os.Exit (see
// TestRunCrossServerTestExitsCode2WhenRefreshHasNoUsableData).
func TestRunCrossServerTestExitsCode3WhenServerEndsSession(t *testing.T) {
	if name := os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_SESSION_ENDED_CASE"); name != "" {
		t.Setenv("HOME", t.TempDir())
		gameAddr := session.StartFakeGameServer(t, sessionEndedServers[name])
		gameHost, gamePort := testutil.SplitHostPortInt(t, gameAddr)
		fakeGSL := testutil.NewFakeGSLServer(t, gsl.LoginServerListRespon{Code: "0"})
		testutil.UseFakeGSLServer(t, fakeGSL)

		runCrossServerTest(crossServerTestOpts{
			ip: gameHost, port: gamePort, zone: "APS1", gameUid: "uid-1", at: "tok-1",
			collect: true,
		})
		return // only reached if runCrossServerTest did not exit
	}

	for name := range sessionEndedServers {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			t.Parallel()
			cmd := exec.Command(os.Args[0], "-test.run=^TestRunCrossServerTestExitsCode3WhenServerEndsSession$")
			cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), "LASTWAR_TEST_SESSION_ENDED_CASE="+name)
			var stderr bytes.Buffer
			cmd.Stderr = &stderr
			runErr := cmd.Run()

			exitErr, ok := runErr.(*exec.ExitError)
			if !ok {
				t.Fatalf("subprocess did not exit with an error: err=%v, stderr=%s", runErr, stderr.String())
			}
			if exitErr.ExitCode() != exitCodeSessionEnded {
				t.Errorf("exit code = %d, want %d; stderr=%s", exitErr.ExitCode(), exitCodeSessionEnded, stderr.String())
			}
			if !strings.Contains(stderr.String(), "the server ended this session") {
				t.Errorf("stderr = %s\nwant the session-ended log line", stderr.String())
			}
		})
	}
}

// TestExitIfSessionEndedReturnsForOtherErrors: every other error, including an auth rejection and
// an ordinary dead connection, falls through to the caller's existing exit-code logic.
func TestExitIfSessionEndedReturnsForOtherErrors(t *testing.T) {
	for _, err := range []error{nil, session.ErrAuthRejected, session.ErrTokenRejected, sfs.NewDeadConnError(os.ErrClosed)} {
		exitIfSessionEnded(err, nil) // would kill the test binary if it exited
	}
}
```

`internal/app/main_shumei_test.go`:

```go
package app

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"lastwar-client/internal/gsl"
	"lastwar-client/internal/session"
	"lastwar-client/internal/shumei"
	"lastwar-client/internal/testutil"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"testing/synctest"
	"time"
)

// shumeiReply is a shumei.Client that answers every device-profile POST with body, counting calls.
type shumeiReply struct {
	body  string
	calls int
}

func (s *shumeiReply) Do(*http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	s.calls++
	return &http.Response{StatusCode: http.StatusOK, Body: io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader(s.body)), Header: http.Header{}}, nil
}

const (
	shumeiSmid1 = `{"code":1100,"detail":{"deviceId":"smid-1"},"requestId":"r-1"}`
	shumeiSmid2 = `{"code":1100,"detail":{"deviceId":"smid-2"},"requestId":"r-2"}`
)

// writeTestSessionConfig saves cfg to a fresh session config file and returns its path.
func writeTestSessionConfig(t *testing.T, cfg *SessionConfig) string {
	t.Helper()
	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "session.json")
	if err := SaveSessionConfig(cfg, path); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("SaveSessionConfig: %v", err)
	}
	return path
}

// sameInstall compares two installs field by field, times with Equal, so one read back from JSON
// matches the one that was saved.
func sameInstall(a, b shumei.Install) bool {
	return a.DeviceID == b.DeviceID && a.AndroidID == b.AndroidID && a.MediaDrmID == b.MediaDrmID &&
		a.PUUID == b.PUUID && a.BoxID == b.BoxID &&
		a.FirstInstallTime.Equal(b.FirstInstallTime) && a.LastUpdateTime.Equal(b.LastUpdateTime) &&
		a.BoxIDSavedAt.Equal(b.BoxIDSavedAt)
}

// TestMintShumeiBoxIDKeepsInstall checks the first -cs-shumei-gen run for a session fills its
// install values, binds them to the run's deviceId and saves them, with the minted box ID, to the
// session config without touching the file's other fields. A later run getting the same smid back
// leaves the file alone; one getting a new smid saves it.
func TestMintShumeiBoxIDKeepsInstall(t *testing.T) {
	path := writeTestSessionConfig(t, &SessionConfig{
		DeviceID: "dev-1", AccessToken: "tok-1", RefreshToken: "rt-1", RefreshTokenTime: 42,
	})
	client := &shumeiReply{body: shumeiSmid1}

	boxID, install := mintShumeiBoxID(client, "dev-1", shumei.Device{}, shumei.Install{}, path)
	if boxID != "Bsmid-1" {
		t.Fatalf("boxID = %q, want Bsmid-1", boxID)
	}
	if install.DeviceID != "dev-1" || install.BoxID != "Bsmid-1" || install.BoxIDSavedAt.IsZero() || install.AndroidID == "" || install.PUUID == "" {
		t.Errorf("install = %+v, want filled values bound to dev-1, and the minted box ID with its save time", install)
	}
	saved, err := LoadSessionConfig(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("LoadSessionConfig: %v", err)
	}
	if !sameInstall(saved.ShumeiInstall, install) {
		t.Errorf("saved shumeiInstall = %+v, want %+v", saved.ShumeiInstall, install)
	}
	if saved.AccessToken != "tok-1" || saved.RefreshToken != "rt-1" || saved.RefreshTokenTime != 42 || saved.ShumeiBoxId != "" {
		t.Errorf("saving the install changed other fields: %+v", *saved)
	}

	// Same phone, same smid back: nothing changed, so nothing is written. The file is rewritten
	// as compact JSON first; a save would indent it again, as the first one did.
	indented, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil || !bytes.Contains(indented, []byte("\n  ")) {
		t.Fatalf("first save wrote %q (read error %v), want indented JSON for the check below to mean anything", indented, err)
	}
	compact, err := json.Marshal(saved)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, compact, 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	boxID, again := mintShumeiBoxID(client, "dev-1", shumei.Device{}, saved.ShumeiInstall, path)
	if boxID != "Bsmid-1" || !sameInstall(again, install) {
		t.Errorf("second run = %q, %+v; want Bsmid-1 and the install unchanged", boxID, again)
	}
	if after, err := os.ReadFile(path); err != nil || string(after) != string(compact) {
		t.Errorf("second run rewrote the session config (read error %v); want it untouched", err)
	}

	// A new smid, what the live server returns on every registration, is saved with its time.
	client.body = shumeiSmid2
	boxID, next := mintShumeiBoxID(client, "dev-1", shumei.Device{}, again, path)
	if boxID != "Bsmid-2" || next.BoxID != "Bsmid-2" || next.BoxIDSavedAt.Before(install.BoxIDSavedAt) {
		t.Errorf("third run = %q, %+v; want Bsmid-2 saved no earlier than %v", boxID, next, install.BoxIDSavedAt)
	}
	if saved, err := LoadSessionConfig(path); err != nil || !sameInstall(saved.ShumeiInstall, next) {
		t.Errorf("after a new smid the config holds %+v (load error %v), want %+v", saved.ShumeiInstall, err, next)
	}
	if client.calls != 3 {
		t.Errorf("device-profile calls = %d, want 3: every run registers, as the SDK does on each launch", client.calls)
	}
}

// TestMintShumeiBoxIDOtherDeviceID checks one deviceId's install is never sent or saved under
// another. A run whose -cs-deviceid overrides the config's registers a fresh install and leaves the
// config's alone; a config whose deviceId itself changed gets a fresh install saved for it.
func TestMintShumeiBoxIDOtherDeviceID(t *testing.T) {
	_, d1Install := mintShumeiBoxID(&shumeiReply{body: shumeiSmid1}, "dev-1", shumei.Device{}, shumei.Install{}, "")

	path := writeTestSessionConfig(t, &SessionConfig{DeviceID: "dev-1", ShumeiInstall: d1Install})
	before, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	_, got := mintShumeiBoxID(&shumeiReply{body: shumeiSmid2}, "dev-2", shumei.Device{}, d1Install, path)
	if got.DeviceID != "dev-2" || got.AndroidID == d1Install.AndroidID || got.PUUID == d1Install.PUUID || got.BoxID != "Bsmid-2" {
		t.Errorf("install for dev-2 = %+v, want a fresh one bound to dev-2, not dev-1's %+v", got, d1Install)
	}
	if after, err := os.ReadFile(path); err != nil || string(after) != string(before) {
		t.Errorf("the dev-2 run rewrote dev-1's session config (read error %v); want it untouched", err)
	}

	path = writeTestSessionConfig(t, &SessionConfig{DeviceID: "dev-2", ShumeiInstall: d1Install})
	_, got = mintShumeiBoxID(&shumeiReply{body: shumeiSmid2}, "dev-2", shumei.Device{}, d1Install, path)
	if saved, err := LoadSessionConfig(path); err != nil || saved.ShumeiInstall.DeviceID != "dev-2" || !sameInstall(saved.ShumeiInstall, got) {
		t.Errorf("config moved to dev-2 holds %+v (load error %v), want the fresh dev-2 install %+v", saved.ShumeiInstall, err, got)
	}
}

// TestMintShumeiBoxIDConfigWithoutDeviceID checks a session config without a top-level deviceId
// still keeps its install, and that the install already there then owns the slot: a run under
// another deviceId can't replace it.
func TestMintShumeiBoxIDConfigWithoutDeviceID(t *testing.T) {
	path := writeTestSessionConfig(t, &SessionConfig{AccessToken: "tok-1"})
	_, install := mintShumeiBoxID(&shumeiReply{body: shumeiSmid1}, "dev-1", shumei.Device{}, shumei.Install{}, path)
	saved, err := LoadSessionConfig(path)
	if err != nil || saved.ShumeiInstall.DeviceID != "dev-1" || !sameInstall(saved.ShumeiInstall, install) {
		t.Fatalf("config without a deviceId holds %+v (load error %v), want the dev-1 install %+v", saved.ShumeiInstall, err, install)
	}

	before, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	_, other := mintShumeiBoxID(&shumeiReply{body: shumeiSmid2}, "dev-2", shumei.Device{}, saved.ShumeiInstall, path)
	if other.DeviceID != "dev-2" || other.AndroidID == install.AndroidID {
		t.Errorf("install for dev-2 = %+v, want a fresh one, not dev-1's", other)
	}
	if after, err := os.ReadFile(path); err != nil || string(after) != string(before) {
		t.Errorf("the dev-2 run replaced dev-1's install in a config without a deviceId (read error %v); want it untouched", err)
	}

	// The install's own deviceId keeps saving: a later dev-1 run's new smid is stored.
	_, next := mintShumeiBoxID(&shumeiReply{body: shumeiSmid2}, "dev-1", shumei.Device{}, saved.ShumeiInstall, path)
	if again, err := LoadSessionConfig(path); err != nil || again.ShumeiInstall.BoxID != "Bsmid-2" || !sameInstall(again.ShumeiInstall, next) {
		t.Errorf("after dev-1's next run the config holds %+v (load error %v), want %+v with Bsmid-2", again.ShumeiInstall, err, next)
	}
}

// TestMintShumeiBoxIDFailure checks a failed registration falls back to an empty box ID but

// TestMintsShumeiBoxID pins when runCrossServerTest registers, which is also when Run checks the
// session config's shumeiInstall.
func TestMintsShumeiBoxID(t *testing.T) {
	for _, c := range []struct {

	}{

// TestRunShumeiInstallGate checks Run refuses a session config whose shumeiInstall a real install
// couldn't hold on exactly the runs that register (-cs-shumei-gen, no shumeiBoxId, not iOS), and
// lets every other run through. Run calls os.Exit, so each case re-executes the test binary as a
// subprocess (see TestMainFlagParseExitCodes). The child points check-version at a closed local
// port, so no case reaches a real server even if the gate regresses. Where Run stopped is read
// off the device-id file: runCrossServerTest creates it first thing, so it exists only for a run
// that got past the gate.
func TestRunShumeiInstallGate(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_HELPER_PROCESS") == "1" {
		gsl.CheckVersionHosts = []string{"http://127.0.0.1:1"}
		os.Args = append([]string{"lastwar-client", "-config", os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_CONFIG")}, strings.Fields(os.Getenv("LASTWAR_TEST_ARGS"))...)
		Run()
		return
	}

	path := writeTestSessionConfig(t, &SessionConfig{
		DeviceID: "dev-1", AccessToken: "tok-1",
		ShumeiInstall: shumei.Install{AndroidID: "NOT-AN-ANDROID-ID"},
	})
	for _, c := range []struct {
		name, args string
		gated      bool
	}{
		{"mints", "-cs-shumei-gen", true},
		{"shumeiBoxId given", "-cs-shumei-gen -cs-shumei Bsmid", false},
		{"iOS mode", "-cs-shumei-gen -cs-ios", false},
		{"no -cs-shumei-gen", "", false},
	} {
		t.Run(c.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			home := t.TempDir()
			cmd := exec.Command(os.Args[0], "-test.run=^TestRunShumeiInstallGate$")
			cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), "LASTWAR_TEST_HELPER_PROCESS=1", "LASTWAR_TEST_CONFIG="+path,
				"LASTWAR_TEST_ARGS="+c.args, "HOME="+home, "LASTWAR_STATE_DIR=")
			var stderr bytes.Buffer
			cmd.Stderr = &stderr
			runErr := cmd.Run()

			// Every case exits 1: the gated one at the gate, the rest later, for want of an ip.
			if exitErr, ok := runErr.(*exec.ExitError); !ok || exitErr.ExitCode() != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("subprocess = %v, want exit 1; stderr=%s", runErr, stderr.String())
			}
			gated := strings.Contains(stderr.String(), "invalid shumeiInstall")
			_, statErr := os.Stat(filepath.Join(home, ".lastwar_goclient_device_id"))
			pastGate := statErr == nil
			if gated != c.gated || pastGate == c.gated {
				t.Errorf("gate logged %v, run continued past it %v; want gated %v; stderr=%s", gated, pastGate, c.gated, stderr.String())
			}
			if strings.Contains(stderr.String(), "NOT-AN-ANDROID-ID") {
				t.Errorf("stderr = %s, which logs the androidId value itself", stderr.String())
			}
		})
	}
}

// runSaveBack drives runCrossServerTest through a -cs-rt refresh that changes the access token,
// so it saves the session config back (see TestRunCrossServerTestRtRefreshPersistsFreshAccessToken),
// with ShuMei's deviceprofile/v4 answering smid-1. It returns the config as saved.
func runSaveBack(t *testing.T, o crossServerTestOpts) SessionConfig {
	t.Helper()
	t.Setenv("HOME", t.TempDir())
	gslClient := testutil.UseInMemoryGSL(t, gsl.LoginServerListRespon{
		Code:       "0",
		ServerList: []gsl.LoginServerInfo{{IP: "10.9.8.7", Port: testutil.FlexPort(20443), Zone: "APS-REAL", GameUid: "uid-real"}},
		At:         &gsl.LoginToken{Token: "fresh-access-token"},
	})
	inner := gslClient.Transport
	o.httpClient = &http.Client{Transport: roundTripFunc(func(r *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
		if strings.HasSuffix(r.URL.Path, "/deviceprofile/v4") {
			return &http.Response{StatusCode: http.StatusOK, Body: io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader(shumeiSmid1)), Header: http.Header{}}, nil
		}
		return inner.RoundTrip(r)
	})}
	o.ip, o.port, o.zone, o.gameUid, o.at, o.rt = "stale-host", 1, "APS-STALE", "uid-stale", "stale-token", "some-refresh-token"

	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		o.dialGame = session.NewInMemoryGameDial(session.FakeInitPushServer(nil))
		runCrossServerTest(o)
		synctest.Wait()
	})
	saved, err := LoadSessionConfig(o.configSavePath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("LoadSessionConfig: %v", err)
	}
	if saved.AccessToken != "fresh-access-token" {
		t.Fatalf("saved accessToken = %q, want the refreshed one: the save-back didn't run", saved.AccessToken)
	}
	return *saved
}

// TestRunCrossServerTestSaveBackKeepsMintedInstall checks the redirect/refresh save-back stores
// the install as the mint left it, and keeps the minted box ID out of the top-level shumeiBoxId,
// where it would stop later runs registering.
func TestRunCrossServerTestSaveBackKeepsMintedInstall(t *testing.T) {
	path := writeTestSessionConfig(t, &SessionConfig{DeviceID: "dev-1"})
	saved := runSaveBack(t, crossServerTestOpts{deviceID: "dev-1", shumeiGen: true, configSavePath: path})
	if saved.ShumeiBoxId != "" {
		t.Errorf("saved shumeiBoxId = %q, want it left empty: the minted one belongs in shumeiInstall", saved.ShumeiBoxId)
	}
	if in := saved.ShumeiInstall; in.BoxID != "Bsmid-1" || in.DeviceID != "dev-1" || in.AndroidID == "" {
		t.Errorf("saved shumeiInstall = %+v, want the minted Bsmid-1 on a filled install bound to dev-1", in)
	}
}

// TestRunCrossServerTestSaveBackDropsOtherDeviceInstall checks the save-back, which writes this
// run's deviceId, doesn't keep another deviceId's install next to it.
func TestRunCrossServerTestSaveBackDropsOtherDeviceInstall(t *testing.T) {
	d1Install := shumei.Install{DeviceID: "dev-1", AndroidID: "3f9c1e0a7b2d4c58", BoxID: "Bsmid-0", BoxIDSavedAt: time.UnixMilli(1789500000000)}
	path := writeTestSessionConfig(t, &SessionConfig{DeviceID: "dev-1", ShumeiInstall: d1Install})
	saved := runSaveBack(t, crossServerTestOpts{deviceID: "dev-2", shumeiInstall: d1Install, configSavePath: path})
	if saved.DeviceID != "dev-2" || saved.ShumeiInstall != (shumei.Install{}) {
		t.Errorf("saved deviceId %q with shumeiInstall %+v, want dev-2 with no install", saved.DeviceID, saved.ShumeiInstall)
	}
}

// TestRunCrossServerTestSaveBackWritesNoStubInstall checks a run that never had an install (no
// -cs-shumei-gen here; iOS and a given shumeiBoxId are the same) saves the config back without a

func TestRunCrossServerTestSaveBackWritesNoStubInstall(t *testing.T) {

	}
}

// TestRunCrossServerTestSaveBackKeepsUnboundInstall checks a run that doesn't mint still saves back
// an install pasted without a deviceId, bound to the run's, instead of dropping it.
func TestRunCrossServerTestSaveBackKeepsUnboundInstall(t *testing.T) {

	}
}
```

```go
package app

import (
```
